mapper.select: SELECT i.ITEM_CD, i.SHIPPER_CD, i.ITEM_NM, i.USE_YN, s.SHIPPER_NM FROM ITEM_MST i JOIN SHIPPER s ON i.SHIPPER_CD = s.SHIPPER_CD ORDER BY i.ITEM_CD
SELECT i.ITEM_CD, i.SHIPPER_CD, i.ITEM_NM, i.USE_YN, s.SHIPPER_NM FROM ITEM_MST i JOIN SHIPPER s ON i.SHIPPER_CD = s.SHIPPER_CD WHERE i.ITEM_CD = #{itemCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ITEM_MST (ITEM_CD, SHIPPER_CD, ITEM_NM, USE_YN) VALUES (#{itemCd}, #{shipperCd}, #{itemNm}, #{useYn})
